basic_info.description: Rarely available, fully detached Mediterranean Revival home on coveted Cecilia Ave in Inner Parkside. This 2-bed, 1-bath residence combines classic character with modern upgrades. The remodeled kitchen with breakfast nook/office opens directly to a sun-filled backyard, ideal for entertaining or relaxing. Formal living and dining rooms highlight original wood trim and glass-paneled doors, while the updated bath offers a sleek vanity and walk-in shower. An internal staircase leads to the huge 2-car garage with abundant storage and excellent potential for an ADU or expanded living space. Located near some of the city's best schools and within easy walking distance to West Portal shops, dining, and Muni, this lovingly cared-for home is ready for its next owner.
